inspiration.observed_pattern: The MySQL aggregate reference documents hierarchical GROUP BY ... WITH ROLLUP totals and JSON_OBJECTAGG key/value aggregation as adjacent aggregate capabilities.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as one regional revenue manifest. Two rows produce one regional JSON_OBJECTAGG map and a rollup map with an ALL prefix plus the grand total; the source tables, names, values, and documentation examples are not copied.

fixture_notes: Region west has two distinct item codes. The grouped row maps west:item keys, and the NULL region rollup maps ALL:item keys without duplicate-key ambiguity.
determinism_notes: Sale IDs, region, item codes, revenue values, JSON keys, grouping, and result ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE regional_revenue_min (sale_id INT PRIMARY KEY, region_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, item_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, revenue INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT region_code, JSON_OBJECTAGG(CONCAT(COALESCE(region_code, 'ALL'), ':', item_code), revenue) AS revenue_map, SUM(revenue) AS region_total FROM regional_revenue_min GROUP BY region_code WITH ROLLUP

checks.sql: SELECT region_code, JSON_OBJECTAGG(CONCAT(COALESCE(region_code, 'ALL'), ':', item_code), revenue) AS revenue_map, SUM(revenue) AS region_total FROM regional_revenue_min GROUP BY region_code WITH ROLLUP
SELECT sale_id, region_code, item_code, revenue FROM regional_revenue_min ORDER BY sale_id
